title: Legal Secretary
description:
Employment Law Legal Secretary / Paralegal
Location: Crowthorne, Berkshire
Salary: Up to £40,000 per annum (depending on experience)
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:00pm
Working Pattern: Hybrid working 1 2 days from home per week
Contract: Permanent Full-Time
Benefits: Free on-site parking
About the Opportunity We are currently recruiting for an experienced Employment Law Legal Secretary / Paralegal to join a well-established and reputable legal practice based in Crowthorne, Berkshire.
This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised and proactive legal professional looking to develop their career within Employment Law.
The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting fee earners, ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day legal operations and delivering an exceptional level of service to clients.
Key Responsibilities
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to fee earners within the Employment Law department.
- Preparing, drafting, formatting and proofreading legal documents and correspondence.
- Managing diaries, scheduling appointments and coordinating meetings.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files, case records and documentation.
- Liaising professionally with clients, solicitors and external third parties.
- Assisting with case preparation and general paralegal duties where required.
- Managing incoming enquiries, emails and correspondence efficiently.
- Ensuring deadlines are met and maintaining a high standard of accuracy and confidentiality.

About You To be considered for this opportunity, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary, Legal Administrator or Paralegal is essential.
- Experience within Employment Law would be highly advantageous.
- Excellent organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to prioritise competing deadlines and manage a busy workload.
- Confidence working independently while supporting a wider legal team.
- A professional, proactive and approachable manner.
- Strong IT skills and experience preparing legal documentation.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of up to £40,000, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working flexibility, with 1 2 days working from home.
- Monday to Friday working hours, 9:00am 5:00pm.
- Free car parking.
- The opportunity to join an established legal practice.
- A stable, long-term career opportunity within a professional and supportive environment.

title: Litigation Legal Assistant / Secretary
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
I am recruiting for a well established, leading Law firm in Slough who is looking for a secretary or paralegal with experience to support a friendly and fast paced Litigation department, contentious work ranging from disputes between married or unmarried couples, commercial and civil claims, contested wills and employment work. This role offers training and development, excellent benefits and competitive salary. This is an office based role, the position could be full or part time for the right person.

Responsibilities:
- Assist Solicitors in managing a diverse caseload of family law matters, civil and commercial disputes and contentious work.
- Conduct thorough legal research and prepare relevant documentation for client cases.
- Coordinate and schedule client meetings, court appearances, and other appointments.
- Maintain accurate and organized case files and documents.
- Draft legal correspondence, petitions, and motions.
- Communicate with clients, opposing counsel, and court personnel professionally and effectively.
- Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits and assisting with courtroom logistics.
- Stay updated on changes in family law regulations and procedures.

Please apply asap, this is a fantastic opportunity to work for a progressive law firm.

title: Paralegal
description:
Fully office based

No car parking, but street parking a short walk from the office

Are you an experienced Paralegal with a passion for Residential Conveyancing? Our client, a well-respected law firm in Wokingham, is seeking a dedicated professional to join their dynamic and expanding team. This full-time role offers not only a competitive salary but also a comprehensive benefits package, making it an excellent career move for the right candidate.

Working in a supportive environment where your skills are valued and your contributions make a real difference. You will be working with experienced solicitors on a diverse caseload, enhancing your expertise and broadening your professional experience. The firm prides itself on its client-focused approach, and you will play a crucial role in delivering exceptional service.

The person:
- The ideal candidate will bring a wealth of experience from a similar role within the legal sector, particularly in Conveyancing processes and procedures.
- Familiarity with Tikit Partner for Windows is a plus, but more importantly, you should possess outstanding client care skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
- Your organisational prowess and team spirit will be essential in ensuring the smooth handling of administrative duties
- Proficiency in modern IT systems, audio and copy typing, and diary management is crucial
- Confidentiality and meticulous attention to detail are paramount in this position

In this role, you will:
- Open files - Drafting contract packs
- Dealing with post-exchange administration
- Handling Land Registry requisitions
- Manage and respond to calls
- Provide updates to clients, estate agents, lenders, and solicitors
- Ensure all files are fully compliant

If you are ready to take the next step in your career and have the relevant experience, we would be delighted to hear from you.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
